title: King Palm
body:
Description

The King Palm tree can be found near the beach alongside it's smaller and lighter palm tree.

It sells for less than Oak and it's smaller counterpart, so selling King Palm isn't the best way to make money. Sanding King Palm is difficult, as the trunk is often so large that the player will have to cut it into smaller pieces in order to be able to sand it.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for $1.5 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $7 per stud. You can also use a Planker to get the Planked version, which sells for $8.75 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked King Palm to complete schematics.

You can find bananas on King Palms.

Trivia

  • The difference between the King Palm and the Palm is that the King Palm has a darker and more desaturated log.
